records.context: The OPS flat-microscope field of view of item 912 in the general correction (item 933). The nuclear image data channel's map is fitted to the nuclei themselves: the median raw nuclear intensity per map cell, a count-weighted local quadratic fit of its log above the camera offset, 1 over the central square, read at block centres. A nucleus is bright where the light is, so the map follows the illumination into the corners, where a pixel median, which is mostly background between cells, falls less steeply than the cells. That image data channel is corrected with the offset added back. Every other image data channel is estimated by :func:`estimate_illumination` with ``other_estimator``, exactly as it would be on its own.
records.label: spacr.illumination.estimate_nuclear_illumination#1
records.source: The OPS flat-field of item 912 in the general correction (item 933). The nuclear channel's map is fitted to the nuclei themselves: the median raw nuclear intensity per map cell, a count-weighted local quadratic fit of its log above the camera offset, 1 over the central square, read at block centres. A nucleus is bright where the light is, so the map follows the illumination into the corners, where a pixel median, which is mostly background between cells, falls less steeply than the cells. That channel is corrected with the offset added back. Every other channel is estimated by :func:`estimate_illumination` with ``other_estimator``, exactly as it would be on its own.
records.translation: 将 item 912 的 OPS 平场纳入通用校正 (item 933)。细胞核通道的图根据细胞核本身拟合：取每个图单元内原始细胞核强度的中位数，对其高于相机偏移部分的对数进行按计数加权的局部二次拟合，在中央方形区域内为 1，并在块中心处读取。光照强的地方细胞核就亮，因此该图能跟随照明一直延伸到角落；而像素中位数大多是细胞之间的背景，在角落处的下降不如细胞陡峭。该通道在校正时会加回偏移。其他每个通道都由 :func:`estimate_illumination` 使用 ``other_estimator`` 估计，与单独估计时完全相同。

records.context: Check a nuclear-median map on held-out fields, against the polynomial.
records.label: spacr.illumination.validate_illumination#0
records.source: Check a nuclear-median map on held-out fields, against the polynomial.
records.translation: 在留出视野上检验细胞核中位数图，并与多项式比较。

records.context: Per laboratory microplate, ``illumination_holdout_n`` microscope fields of view are drawn (:func:`spacr.ops_flatfield.holdout_fields`, seed ``illumination_seed``) and left out of the nuclear map. Their nuclei are re-measured exactly with each map (:func:`spacr.ops_flatfield.validate_nuclear_flat`): ``(I - b) / F + b`` per pixel, then the nuclear mean. The rings of the radial table are measured from the microscope field of view centre: the OPS rings (0 to 2,100 px) on a microscope field of view that large, else rings at 0, 25, 50, 65, 75, 85, 92 and 100 % of the centre-to-corner distance. Every version is scored on the same held-out nuclei.
records.label: spacr.illumination.validate_illumination#1
records.source: Per plate, ``illumination_holdout_n`` fields are drawn (:func:`spacr.ops_flatfield.holdout_fields`, seed ``illumination_seed``) and left out of the nuclear map. Their nuclei are re-measured exactly with each map (:func:`spacr.ops_flatfield.validate_nuclear_flat`): ``(I - b) / F + b`` per pixel, then the nuclear mean. The rings of the radial table are measured from the field centre: the OPS rings (0 to 2,100 px) on a field that large, else rings at 0, 25, 50, 65, 75, 85, 92 and 100 % of the centre-to-corner distance. Every version is scored on the same held-out nuclei.
records.translation: 每块板抽取 ``illumination_holdout_n`` 个视野（:func:`spacr.ops_flatfield.holdout_fields`，种子 ``illumination_seed``），并将其排除在细胞核图之外。这些视野的细胞核用每张图精确地重新测量（:func:`spacr.ops_flatfield.validate_nuclear_flat`）：逐像素计算 ``(I - b) / F + b``，再求细胞核均值。径向表的环从视野中心开始测量：视野足够大时使用 OPS 环（0 到 2,100 px），否则在中心到角落距离的 0、25、50、65、75、85、92 和 100 % 处设环。每个版本都在相同的留出细胞核上评分。

records.context: The versions are the raw nuclear mean (``as measured``), the nuclear map (``exact_nuclear_median``) and the polynomial microscope field of view of the same channel from :func:`estimate_illumination` (``exact_polynomial``). The polynomial is estimated from up to ``illumination_max_fields`` microscope fields of view of the whole laboratory microplate, held-out ones included, and is applied here with the same offset added back, so the comparison does not favour the nuclear map.
records.label: spacr.illumination.validate_illumination#2
records.source: The versions are the raw nuclear mean (``as measured``), the nuclear map (``exact_nuclear_median``) and the polynomial field of the same channel from :func:`estimate_illumination` (``exact_polynomial``). The polynomial is estimated from up to ``illumination_max_fields`` fields of the whole plate, held-out ones included, and is applied here with the same offset added back, so the comparison does not favour the nuclear map.
records.translation: 这些版本是原始细胞核均值（``as measured``）、细胞核图（``exact_nuclear_median``），以及 :func:`estimate_illumination` 给出的同一通道的多项式场（``exact_polynomial``）。多项式根据全板最多 ``illumination_max_fields`` 个视野估计（包括留出视野），并在此以同样加回偏移的方式应用，因此比较不会偏向细胞核图。
